0022600006.text: The Cavaliers open their 2026-27 season at Philadelphia, where the 76ers are 1-0 overall, 1-0 on the road, and on a W1 streak, sitting 1st in the Atlantic and 2nd in the East. Cleveland won the 2025-26 season series 4-0, with the most recent meeting on March 9, 2026, a 115-101 Cavaliers win in Cleveland, and no games yet this season between the two. Cleveland's Nae'Qwan Tomlin is out with a back issue, while Khalifa Diop (knee) and Sam Merrill (elbow soreness) are day-to-day and game-time decisions, and Philadelphia's Ariel Hukporti is out with a ruptured Achilles, Dominick Barlow is out with a back issue, and Dean Wade (ankle sprain) and Tacko Fall (hip) are day-to-day and game-time decisions.
